main_text.p: conabimur:in qua Ciceroni primum gra-tias Plancus agit: deinde in se collata be-neficia recenset atq; amplificat. Tum eun-demrogat, vt & porrò in Senatu sese de-fendere velit. Postremò suam in Repub.de fendenda[?] fidem:in amicitia memoriâ atq; gratitudinem defert ac pollicetur: simul etiam quæ in bello contra Antonium ge-rendo propositâ habeat consilia, indicat. Sententiæ erunt tales.
I. Magnas tibi nunc, vti debeo, ago gratias: maiores habeo, & habiturus sum dum anima spirabo mea: relaturum me affirmare mea me non finit tc[?]-nuitas.
II. Tot enim tantaq; tua in me extant promerita: vt vix illa percensere numerando, nedum remunera-tione explere aliqua possim.
III. Nisi forte, quæ tua est humanitas, retulisse me gratiam existimaueris, si memoria ea tenuero.

IIII. Si de propinquorum, aut etiam liberorum agendum tibi rebus esset: maiorem profecto curam, fidem, diligentiā adhibere nō posses, quā in hac mea molesta sane ac difficili fatis adhibere te intelligo.
V. Quot enim quantosq; mei causa labores susti-neas: quorum hominum odium tibi atq; inuidiam concilies: quibus cum iurgiis propter me contendas, cognitum iam dudum exploratumq; habeo.
VI. Itaq; hæc nunc cura animo erit meo infixa

page.notes: Catchword "perpe-" printed at the lower right. The text ends with "infixa" on the last full line. Doubtful readings: "eun-demrogat" (the line-end word appears printed without a space, kept as printed); "fendenda" after "Repub.de" (the initial letter looks like a long s/f, probably "defendenda" split across lines, marked [?]); "tc-nuitas" (the first letter of the split word looks like a damaged "te", marked [?]). Long s was normalised to plain s throughout, as the rules require. Printing errors left as printed: "eun-demrogat", "fendenda", "tc-nuitas".
